imageNote: This is a two-vendor topic per the course brief, so both vendors were checked. Snowflake's own quickstarts/partner pages describe Power BI connectivity only in prose with no Power BI UI screenshots. Microsoft's Power Query connector reference page (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-query/connectors/snowflake, which desktop-connect-snowflake redirects to) is JS-rendered, so a Browser javascript_tool img.src scan was used per the course's established Microsoft-docs gotcha, and it directly names Get Data/connection/authentication screenshots. These three cover the complete real connect flow the lesson describes: choosing the connector, entering server/warehouse, and authenticating.
